# Vurell

> Vurell is a go-to-market (GTM) service for software companies. It finds the companies in Europe that need what a client builds right now, through public signals in company registers, job boards and funding news across Europe, writes to them in the client's name, follows up by phone, and runs the first call itself (English, French, Ukrainian or Russian). The companies that are ready are handed to the client's team with notes, and the client sells. Price: a month-to-month pilot at €100 a month for the first two months and €300 a month from the third, plus €300 for each qualified call handed over. No minimum term. A sending domain of the client's own costs from €40, paid with the first month, and takes about two weeks to warm up. A second option, sales on retainer, takes the deal to signature: €500 a month (minimum 3 months) plus 15% of first-year contract value under €20k or 10% from €20k, (for monthly SaaS, the customer's whole first monthly payment instead), for companies selling in the UK, the US or Ukraine.

Vurell is run by Myroslav Sabelnykov, a registered French sole trader (76 rue Pierre Julien, 26200 Montélimar, France). Contact: miro@vurell.com.

Who it is for: software companies with 5 to 100 people where the founder still sells (development studios, outsourcers, SaaS, custom software), from any country, selling into any country in Europe.

What counts as a qualified call: a company that fits criteria agreed in writing before the pilot (company size, country, role of the person), where Vurell has held the first call with a decision-maker and handed it to the client with notes. A call that does not happen, or a company that does not fit, is not billed. Vurell does not promise that a company will buy.

## Data

- [German developer roles open 30 days or more](https://vurell.com/data/developer-hiring-germany/): a monthly snapshot of every software developer posting by small and mid-sized employers on the German Federal Employment Agency job board, by stack, state, city and age. CC BY 4.0. Raw figures: [report.json](https://vurell.com/data/developer-hiring-germany/report.json), [report.csv](https://vurell.com/data/developer-hiring-germany/report.csv)

## Signals tracked

- Software development and outsourcing: a developer role open for 30 days or more (German Federal Employment Agency job board)
- Business software for small firms: a firm of 6 to 49 people hiring an office assistant, or a company that just moved into the next size band (French company register, job boards)
- Other software: a signal picked with the client before the pilot starts
